desc.zh: 客機於大雨中降落時偏離跑道進入泥地，機上151人全數安全疏散無人受傷。
desc.en: The aircraft ran off the runway into mud while landing in heavy rain; all 151 occupants evacuated safely with no injuries.

desc.zh: 一架FlyArystan空中巴士A320客機於阿拉木圖機場維修期間，前起落架艙冒出濃煙與火光並起火。
desc.en: A FlyArystan Airbus A320 caught fire in the nose gear bay during routine maintenance at Almaty Airport.

desc.zh: 貨機降落時煞車鎖死導致四條輪胎爆胎並起火，無人受傷。
desc.en: Freighter suffered brake lockup during landing, blowing four tires and catching fire; no injuries reported.

location.zh: 美國華盛頓特區，雷根國家機場以北2海浬
location.en: 2 miles north of DCA, Washington, D.C., USA

desc.zh: 總統直升機海軍陸戰隊一號與特快航空噴射機在無線電失效後近距離接近，雙方維持700英尺垂直間隔。
desc.en: Presidential helicopter Marine One and Envoy Air regional jet came into close proximity following radio communications failure, maintaining 700 ft vertical separation.

desc.zh: 關鍵飛行控制系統喪失4秒，俯衡約300英尺
desc.en: Lost critical flight controls for 4 seconds, descending about 300 feet

aircraft: Boeing 737 (Virgin Australia VH-IXJ and Qantas VH-VZV)

desc.zh: 維珍機組讀回錯誤未被察覺，導致與澳洲航空機組在滑行道發生衝突
desc.en: Virgin crew incorrect readback not detected, leading to taxiway conflict with Qantas aircraft

desc.zh: 美國航空一架737在芝加哥奧黑爾發生雙輪爆胎，為該機場自8月13日以來第5起輪胎事故。
desc.en: An American Airlines 737 suffered a double tire blowout at Chicago O'Hare, the fifth tire failure at the airport since August 13.

location.zh: 伊朗馬什哈德國際機場（MHD）

desc.zh: 客機降落後偏離跑道並進入未鋪設區域，前起落架塌陷，機上127名乘客與機組員安全疏散。
desc.en: The aircraft veered off the runway after landing and entered an unpaved area, coming to a stop with its nose gear collapsed. All 127 passengers and crew evacuated safely.

desc.zh: 客機因經濟艙出現刺鼻異味宣佈緊急狀態並備降拉傑斯機場，機上幾名人員接受預防性檢查。
desc.en: Aircraft declared an emergency and diverted to Lajes Airport due to a pungent odor in the economy cabin, with several individuals receiving precautionary medical exams.

desc.zh: 一名 Samsic 機場員工遭正在後退的 French Bee 客機撞擊身亡
desc.en: A Samsic airport employee was struck and killed by a backing up French Bee aircraft

location.zh: 德國萊比錫/哈雷機場附近

desc.zh: 萊比錫/哈雷機場附近發現第三架無人機與炸藥，先前曾有一架無人機撞擊DHL貨機並造成尾翼受損。
desc.en: A third drone and explosives were found near Leipzig/Halle Airport following a prior drone collision with a DHL cargo aircraft that damaged its tail section.

location.zh: 加拿大蒙特婁皮埃爾·埃利奧特·特魯多國際機場（YUL）
location.en: Montreal-Pierre Elliott Trudeau International Airport (YUL), Canada

desc.zh: 一名地勤引導員在停機坪遭法國蜜蜂航空空中巴士 A350-900 客機撞擊受重傷，經緊急救護送醫治療。
desc.en: A ground signaller suffered serious injuries after being struck by a French bee Airbus A350-900 aircraft on the apron and was transported to hospital.

desc.zh: 客機在飛往羅馬途中遭遇機械緊急狀況，隨後安全改降加拿大紐芬蘭。
desc.en: The aircraft experienced a mechanical emergency while en route to Rome and diverted to Newfoundland, Canada.

location.zh: 索爾諾克（Szolnok）軍事基地附近

desc.zh: 飛行員彈射逃生並送醫，初步無其他人員受傷。
desc.en: Pilot ejected and taken to hospital; no other injuries reported.

location.zh: 美國亞特蘭大至達拉斯-沃斯堡航線
location.en: En route from Atlanta (ATL) to Dallas-Fort Worth (DFW)

desc.zh: 客艙後方手提電腦電池起火冒煙，機組人員成功撲滅火勢，航機降落後至少4人受輕微灼傷。
desc.en: A laptop battery caught fire in the rear cabin; cabin crew extinguished the fire and the aircraft landed safely, leaving at least four people with minor burns.

location.zh: 芝加哥奧黑爾國際機場

desc.zh: 客機於降落後滑行前往登機門時發生輪胎爆裂
desc.en: The aircraft blew a tire while taxiing to the gate after landing

location.zh: 美國阿拉斯加州紐恩漢角

desc.zh: 一架載有8人的塞斯納441包機在阿拉斯加州紐恩漢角長程雷達站機場附近墜毀，機上無人生還。
desc.en: A chartered Cessna 441 carrying eight people crashed near Cape Newenham Long Range Radar Site Airport in Alaska, killing all on board.

desc.zh: 機艙內筆記型電腦起火，經空服員控制，傳4至5名乘客燒燙傷
desc.en: A laptop caught fire in the cabin and was contained by crew members, with 4 to 5 passengers reportedly burned

desc.zh: 右側發動機故障被迫返航亞特蘭大
desc.en: Right engine glitch forced return to Atlanta

location.zh: 美國阿拉斯加州紐恩漢角長程雷達站機場附近
location.en: Near Cape Newenham Long Range Radar Site Airport, Alaska, US

desc.zh: 包機在接近紐恩漢角長程雷達站機場時墜毀，機上8人全部罹難。
desc.en: Chartered aircraft crashed while approaching Cape Newenham Long Range Radar Site Airport, killing all eight people on board.

desc.zh: 客機於起飛時疑超越跑道末端並發生機尾擦地，隨後降落，德國BFU已展開調查。
desc.en: The aircraft suffered a tail strike after appearing to overrun the runway end during take-off before landing; BFU is investigating.

location.zh: 美國賓夕法尼亞州卡萊爾機場

desc.zh: 賽斯納150飛機於降落時與懸停訓練中的警用直升機相撞，致小型飛機飛行員罹難、直升機兩人受輕傷。
desc.en: A Cessna 150 collided with a hovering police helicopter during landing attempt, killing the airplane pilot and injuring two officers on the helicopter.

desc.zh: 一架塞斯納150小型飛機與賓夕法尼亞州警直升機在空中相撞，導致飛機飛行員死亡及兩名州警受傷。
desc.en: A Cessna 150 light aircraft collided midair with a Pennsylvania State Police helicopter, killing the plane's pilot and injuring two state troopers.

location.zh: 肯亞桑布魯郡奧洛洛奎山附近
location.en: Near Mount Ololokwe, Samburu County, Kenya

desc.zh: 一架載有七人的直升機墜毀，機上所有人全數罹難。
desc.en: A helicopter carrying seven people crashed, killing everyone on board.

location.zh: 美國俄亥俄州阿克倫-坎頓機場

desc.zh: 前起落架無法正常放下，航機於跑道迫降，機頭與機底受損，兩名機組員未受傷。
desc.en: Nose landing gear failed to extend, forcing the aircraft to make a gear-up landing, causing damage to the nose and underside; two crew members were uninjured.

location.zh: 雪梨機場（SYD）與達拉斯/沃斯堡國際機場（DFW）
location.en: Sydney Airport (SYD) and Dallas/Fort Worth International Airport (DFW)

desc.zh: 澳洲航空一架空中巴士A380於維修後，機翼內留置工作燈並執飛兩個國際航段，澳洲運輸安全局發布報告。
desc.en: ATSB issued a report on a Qantas Airbus A380 that flew two international sectors with a maintenance work light left inside its wing.

desc.zh: 起飛滑跑期間加速異常並發生擦尾，隨後空中放油返航降落慕尼黑機場。
desc.en: Experienced abnormal acceleration and a tail strike during takeoff roll, then dumped fuel and returned to land at Munich Airport.

phase.zh: 高空訓練飛行中硬著陸
phase.en: hard landing during high-altitude training flight

location.zh: 加州中國湖海軍航空武器站附近山區
location.en: mountainous terrain near Naval Air Weapons Station China Lake, California

desc.zh: 海軍MH-60S海鷹直升機於高空訓練飛行時硬著陸，機上五人由空軍HH-60W直升機救出，無人受傷
desc.en: Navy MH-60S Seahawk hard-landed during high-altitude training flight; five personnel extracted by USAF HH-60Ws without injury

location.zh: 愛達荷州德里格斯-里德紀念機場（DIJ）

desc.zh: 飛機於施工封閉跑道嘗試起飛時撞擊營建材料並導致起落架塌陷
desc.en: Aircraft attempted takeoff from a closed section of runway under construction, hitting construction material and suffering gear collapse

desc.zh: 機翼右側洩漏燃油，經軍機飛行員目視發現並告知後改降巴黎勒布爾熱機場
desc.en: Inflight fuel leak discovered on right wing by fighter pilot, prompting diversion to Paris-Le Bourget Airport

desc.zh: 美航兩架波音737-800客機於鳳凰城空域重複使用相同呼號，航管員保持高度隔離，FAA已展開調查。
desc.en: Two American Airlines Boeing 737-800 aircraft used the same call sign simultaneously over Phoenix; controller maintained separation, FAA investigating.

location.zh: 英國貝德福德郡老沃登機場
location.en: Old Warden Aerodrome, Bedfordshire, United Kingdom

desc.zh: 飛機在降落時發生輕微彈跳並翻覆，導致嚴重受損。
desc.en: The aircraft bounced slightly and flipped over during landing, sustaining substantial damage.

desc.zh: 兩架客機在數小時內相繼發生輪胎爆裂，被迫停止服務檢修，乘客被接駁至航廈。
desc.en: Two aircraft blew tires within hours of each other, forcing them out of service and requiring passenger shuttles.

location.zh: 英國埃塞克斯郡斯托瑪里斯偉大戰爭機場
location.en: Stow Maries Great War Aerodrome, Essex, United Kingdom

desc.zh: 飛機於飛行表演期間受損，飛行員身受重傷，英國航空事故調查局已展開初步評估。
desc.en: Aircraft was damaged during an air show performance, leaving the pilot seriously injured; the UK AAIB is conducting an initial assessment.

location.zh: 美國鳳凰城天港國際機場（PHX）附近空域
location.en: Near Phoenix Sky Harbor International Airport (PHX), United States

desc.zh: 美國航空兩架波音737-800客機在鳳凰城附近空域使用相同呼號「American 2482」同時飛行，管制員採取分流指引維護安全間隔，FAA已展開調查。
desc.en: Two American Airlines Boeing 737-800 aircraft operated simultaneously in the same sector under the duplicate callsign 'American 2482', prompting an FAA investigation.

desc.zh: 一具引擎在空中關閉
desc.en: engine shut down in flight

location.zh: 英國貝德福德郡老沃登機場
location.en: Old Warden aerodrome, Bedfordshire, United Kingdom

desc.zh: 一架 1934 年產 de Havilland DH.88 Comet 飛機在降落時翻覆並嚴重受損，飛行員獲救送醫後已出院。
desc.en: A 1934 de Havilland DH.88 Comet overturned on landing and sustained extensive damage; the pilot was rescued and later discharged from the hospital.

desc.zh: A320neo短暫失去關鍵飛行控制約4秒，期間下降約300英尺；空中巴士下令液壓與感測器檢查
desc.en: A320neo briefly lost critical flight controls for about 4 seconds during a 300-ft descent; Airbus ordered hydraulic and sensor checks

desc.zh: 客機起飛時過晚仰角旋轉並衝出跑道，導致機尾受損與穿孔。
desc.en: Aircraft sustained heavy aft scraping and a puncture after a late rotation and runway overrun.

desc.zh: 兩架客機在運作時使用相同的無線電呼號
desc.en: Two aircraft used the same callsign during operations

desc.zh: 跑道入侵；管制員在航空器相距超過0.6英里時撤銷起飛許可
desc.en: Runway incursion; controllers rescinded takeoff clearance while aircraft more than 0.6 miles apart

desc.zh: 發動機風扇葉片斷裂引發引擎故障，碎片擊穿客艙窗戶造成乘客受傷，客機安全返航。
desc.en: Uncontained engine failure following fan blade fracture; debris broke a cabin window causing rapid depressurization and injuring a passenger before safe return.

desc.zh: 客機在起飛過程中因輪胎受損而中止起飛
desc.en: The aircraft aborted its takeoff due to tyre damage

desc.zh: 瑞安航空波音737-800客機於2026年7月10日自塞薩洛尼基起飛後發生引擎扇葉斷裂，碎片擊碎舷窗導致艙壓驟降並造成一名乘客受傷，NTSB初步報告指出該引擎有鳥擊殘留物。
desc.en: A Ryanair Boeing 737-800 experienced a fan blade failure shortly after takeoff from Thessaloniki on July 10, 2026, causing rapid decompression and passenger injury; NTSB preliminary report found bird remains inside the engine.

desc.zh: 商務艙出現煙霧後改降，安全落地；消防檢查未發現火源或異常熱度
desc.en: Diverted after smoke was reported in business class; landed safely and firefighters found no fire or heat
